title: Technology planning, microtexture and revealer tranche
head: be24c225c00cf8c583bf7773ee124d354b91e88b

reviews.classification: partial actual owner read; procedural feasibility, optional microtexture and reveal knowledge kept separate
reviews.disposition:
F1: Actual new review covers original1001–1500: PI4–PI11/PI7a–d, PA/PM/PS/PC/PP/PW/PV/PQ, MS/MB/MT/TMR/MA/MO/MU, SC/SS/SE/SW/SN/SH and RC1–RC15 opening plus G11–G22. B556–B558 cover original1–1500 only. Original1501–2087 and appended notes remain. Source-local reused short codes retain this owner; no linked branch, source/game or worker is reactivated.

F2: PI knowledge-view versus true route preserves attributed uncertainty and actor-safe planning, while a real revealer/oracle may know more. World branch definitions are mechanisms, not category vetoes; unnamed effective alternatives remain possible under AD38. PI product/consumer is useful but a cleaning product need not lower disease, a lamp need not always extend work and a signal network need not expose current prices without actual coverage. PI9/PQ3 are fictional-content presentation proposals, not a new runtime physics/permission rule; this review adds no technical dangerous procedure. Offline authoring, runtime model proposal, schema/feasibility checks and committed native outcome remain different evidence levels.

F3: Preserve actual operation/maintenance/aftermath and supported parallel/delegated work, without mandatory repair burden, hostile counter-function, secrecy risk or weakest-node law for every successful product. Critical-path advice depends on real schedule/resource contention; speeding a noncritical branch can change a different outcome or free capacity. A substitute/improvised method can be superior rather than automatically penalized. PV1 graph depth does not establish market value, PV2 superlinear cost is illustrative balance rather than universal physics, and valid profitable/creation loops remain possible under AD22/AD38. PQ golden fixtures protect declared invariants, not freeze all authored designs across intended revisions or demand exhaustive Cartesian-product testing for every change.

F4: MS sensory descriptions bind actual observed material, actor faculty and instrument/craft-time context. Strong senses may reveal exact facts early, and improved skill need not impose compulsory failure on the first piece. MB injuries/fatigue/nerves, MT wear/lost bits, TMR damage/misfiling and MA accidents are local options, not a tax on ordinary crafting or a reason to fabricate defects for flavor. Flavor-only provenance/calluses cannot become physical truth or a gameplay penalty unless their real mechanism was selected. Optional quiet texture remains valuable independently of another progress unlock. MU current placement follows desktop/design/UR43; copied1366/hover-only/no-new-screen phrases are dated recommendations, not current universal gates.

F5: SC expertise/memory and SS social readings preserve useful imperfect observation and teaching, not compulsory novice delusion, decayed recall, copied bad habits or automatic suspicion/sabotage. Actual source, trait, memory/carrier and supported teacher determine results. Price increase does not uniquely identify a rival's project, and maker marks can be absent/copied/forged; label inferences as such. SW ambient adoption should follow actual or explicitly authored world state, not announce imaginary diffusion from a theme. SN spread/tolerance/threshold models use their real domains, and diminishing returns are not automatic when repeated practice genuinely works.

F6: RC revealers can distinguish belief, true graph, sensory cue, practice, provenance, market cause and rival progress. Their sample limits/growth ladders are palettes rather than mandatory ignorance caps or knowledge grants from merely meeting someone. A powerful true-route/causal faculty can know what ordinary observation cannot; exact outputs follow source/channel/world mechanism and disclosure. Advisor's own knowledge and delegated work are distinct from the player's memory. No planner/revealer/code or current behavior is delivered; all old G/T lane priorities and effort estimates require current owner sequence. No source acquisition, save access, browser/build, migration, worker, deletion, commit or push.
reviews.evidence: Actual original1001–1500 read in five bounded untruncated outputs. Earlier B556/B557 actual1–1000; no linked source or implementation credit.
reviews.reopen: Continue original1501–2087 plus current appended notes; verify original-prefix identity and cumulative ranges before full review.
